timeline.summary: On April 28, 2026, CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed EMS Limited's long-term rating at CRISIL A-/Stable and short-term rating at CRISIL A2+, enhancing rated bank facilities to ₹660 Cr.
On May 4, 2026, EMS Limited received a ₹143.80 Cr Letter of Award from UP Jal Nigam for sewer network and house connection work in Varanasi.
On May 6, 2026, EMS received a ₹64.85 Cr Letter of Award from UP Jal Nigam (Urban), Varanasi for sewer network and house connection work.
EMS Limited’s Board recommended **Rs. 1.5 per share (15%) final dividend** for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval.
Ashish Tomar, Managing Director and CFO, concluded the earnings conference call on May 30, 2026, discussing audited standalone and consolidated financial results for Q4FY26.
On May 30, 2026, EMS Limited held its Q4FY26 earnings call, explaining that external delays and state elections caused a sharp drop in quarterly revenue.
EMS Limited received L-1 status for a ₹102.85 Cr sewerage construction contract from UP Jal Nigam in Varanasi.
